findings.title: Call to no-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled does not match parent signature
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but UsernamePasswordForm only defines protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user). This does not compile, or if it resolves to a different overload it bypasses the null/user checks. The re-authentication gate for the username-only flow is therefore broken.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys disabled for initial login when user is null
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns false when user == null. Both authenticate() and challenge(error,field) now only call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm when a user is already set. The previous code enabled WebAuthn conditional UI whenever passkeys were enabled, including the initial usernameless login with no user in context. This regresses first-login discoverable passkey login, which the tests for the initial page (username webauthn autocomplete + webauth form) depend on.

findings.title: Re-authentication form attributes set on throwaway form instance
findings.body: setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError calls context.form() to set USERNAME_HIDDEN and REGISTRATION_DISABLED, but the challenge/error page is later built from a different context.form() instance (e.g. in AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator.challenge and WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.createErrorResponse/errorChallenge). LoginFormsProvider instances are not shared, so attributes set on the discarded instance are lost and the re-authentication page can render as a normal login/registration page after a bad password or failed passkey.
